notes.title: Update v2.00
notes.notes:
◆Updates　card
　　・New cards and packs have been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/1e7ce48d8d5a1854afaf300c9af7c43f01ecf7f7.png"]

　　・Improved readability of card text.
　competition
　　・The most recent information is now displayed when the user opens the "Open" menu.

　　・Changed so that the name displayed in the log is displayed by the user name that has been set.

　　・Added the ability to check the match log on the results screen.

　　・Timeouts have been implemented for some timings.
　solo mode
　　・Adjustments were made to the “Blue Control” deck.

　　・Added solo mode enemies.

　　・The tutorial can now be tried again from the solo mode screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/708aa9e3a852657c1296c509c454176deaf9b1c8.png"]
　store
　　・Mission accomplishment has been made easier to understand.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/3479c17ce22db9afabe55bb0d6b3aa09f8ee2c52.png"]
　Other
　　・Fixed other minor bugs.
◆adjustment　deck building
　　・The deck construction rule “You must include at least one card with a power of 1-9” has been eliminated.

　　・The number of character cards with the same name that can be included in a deck is now limited to three.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311557/bff1fb3a0b98bb29347d7dc28484a838def91612.png"]
　card　　
　　・The effects of the following cards have been adjusted

	大炎上　

	九死に一勝

	捨て札加点
